text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The victor was Mihono Bourbon. Amidst 
roaring cheers, she issued a declaration 
of war to Rice Shower: "At the Kikuka Sho, 
it is you who will be my greatest rival—"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stands are buzzing with excitement. 
Meanwhile, Machikane Tannhauser is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While letting her frustration show at the 
press conference, she displayed her strong 
determination for the upcoming Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her positive words at the press conference 
struck a chord with the audience. 
Matikanetannhauser has no intention of 
losing in the upcoming Kikuka-sho either.
